items.source: Configures the AuditorAware bean to be used to lookup the current principal.

items.source: Configures a DateTimeProvider bean name that allows customizing the date and time to be used for setting creation and modification dates.
items.translation: 配置一个 DateTimeProvider bean 名称，该名称允许自定义用于设置创建和修改日期的日期和时间。
